Required permissions:

GET_PACKAGE_SIZE - Allows the app to find out the space used by installed packages.

To access all device files, the application requests the following permissions.
MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE - Allows full access to external storage in scoped storage.
WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE - Allows the app to write to external storage.
